description_en: Queries the status of clients in the blacklist of a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system
description_zh: 获取CPFS服务中黑名单客户端的状态
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-black-list-clients --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-id cpfs-1234580000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlackListClients

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the file system resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: client_ip

Clients.description_en:
The IDs of clients and the status of each client. This parameter contains a JSON object, for example, {"client1": "EVICTING","client2":"EVICTED"}.

Available client statuses include:

EVICTING indicates that a client is being removed
EVICTED indicates that a client is removed
ACCEPTING indicates that the write access to the file system is being granted to a client
ACCEPTABLE indicates that the write access to the file system is granted to a client
Clients.description_zh:
返回客户端逐出的状态，是一个map类型的JSON格式字符串，格式：`{"client1": "EVICTING","client2":"EVICTED"}`。

客户端逐出状态枚举值：

EVICTING：正在逐出
EVICTED：已逐出
ACCEPTING：恢复中 
ACCEPTABLE：已恢复
